title: Zanzibar Essentials 3-Day Pass

title: Zanzibar Hidden Gems & Sacred Caves (4 Days)
description: Unearth Zanzibar's best-kept secrets beyond the tourist trail: crystal-clear swimming in Maalum Secret Cenote, sacred drumming at Kuza Cave, crossing the submerged 'Moses Road' to untouched Uzi Island, and swimming with rescued sea turtles at Salaam Cave.
includes: Private vehicle and dedicated Swahili guide throughout
Maalum Cave private timed swim slot & Kuza Cave cultural workshop
Uzi Island 4x4 low-tide mangrove causeway expedition & Swahili lunch

title: Adrenaline & Ocean Safari (3 Days)
description: High-octane island thrills: swim bareback with purebred horses in the turquoise shallows of Nungwi or Kiwengwa, power 2-seater quad buggies through coral rock trails and fishing villages, and snorkel the pristine coral gardens of Mnemba Atoll.
includes: Swimming with horses beach session with certified equestrian guides
3-hour guided off-road Quad/ATV adventure with helmets & fuel
Private boat excursion to Mnemba Atoll marine reserve with dolphin spotting
